&DateTimeValue = YMDHMSToT(2024,2,29,23,59,58)
Print(&DateTimeValue.Year())
Print(&DateTimeValue.Month())
Print(&DateTimeValue.Day())
Print(&DateTimeValue.Hour())
Print(&DateTimeValue.Minute())
Print(&DateTimeValue.Second())
&DateTimeOther = &DateTimeValue.AddSeconds(3)
Print(&DateTimeOther.Month())
Print(&DateTimeOther.Day())
Print(&DateTimeOther.Hour())
Print(&DateTimeOther.Second())
&TimeDifference = &DateTimeOther.Difference(&DateTimeValue)
Print(&TimeDifference)
&DateTimeValue.SetEmpty()
If &DateTimeValue.IsEmpty()
Print(1)
Else
Print(0)
EndIf
Print(&DateTimeValue.Year())
Print(&DateTimeValue.Hour())
